thread:
Alex: Heads-up — scheduling compact backfill for user_profiles tonight 02:00 UTC (quiesce window). Will run in small shards, soft-locking rows only. Tagging @oncall and @eng-releases for visibility. :wave:
Maria: Thanks — how long do you expect locks to hold per shard?
Alex: Roughly ~30s per shard, staggered 5s between shards. We'll keep CPU throttle at 60% and pause on pg_lock_wait spike.
Sam: What's the rollback/abort plan if we see increased p99 latency?
Alex: Abort procedure:
```
1) deploy-bot abort <run-id>
2) run: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%compact_backfill%';
3) revert feature flag: ff toggle user_profiles_backfill OFF
```
Alex: Also will spawn a quick read-replica-only patch if abort triggers.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: compact-backfill/user_profiles - run_id=run_202807 - window=2025-06-18T02:00:00Z - canary=5% - owner=Alex
Maria: Can you pin the DB migration version in release notes & tag SRE?
Alex: Yep — pinning v2.4.1-migration in release notes and adding SRE. Link: https://releases/internal/1234
Diana: I'll monitor traces and set an alert for p99>200ms. Adding trace set `user_profiles/compact-backfill`.
Sam: If abort happens, do we need a full schema rollback or just stop the job?
Alex: Just stop the job; compact is additive (cleanup indexes) — no schema revert. We'll mark partial progress and schedule follow-up backfill if needed.
Maria: Ok cool. Who's on call to run the abort if deploy-bot fails?
Diana: I'm standby. @deploy-bot please send a notification to #eng-oncall 5m before start.
deploy-bot: Notification scheduled to #eng-oncall for 2025-06-18T01:55:00Z
Alex: Final checklist:
- pin migration version in release notes
- canary run at 5%
- throttle to 60% CPU
- monitoring & alert set
- abort runbook posted in threads
Alex: I'll post a quick post-deploy summary in this thread after the run. :white_check_mark:
